input.command:
[ -f ~/.cache/larch/sessions/current-design-env-$PPID.sh ] && source ~/.cache/larch/sessions/current-design-env-$PPID.sh
ISSUE_NUMBER=3453

# Fetch issue with 2x retry on transient failure
_attempt=0
_issue_json=""
while [ "$_attempt" -lt 3 ]; do
  _issue_json=$(gh issue view "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --json body,labels,number,title 2>/dev/null) && break
  _attempt=$((_attempt + 1))
  sleep 2
done
if [ -z "$_issue_json" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "**⚠ /design: failed to fetch issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER} after retries**" >&2
  exit 1
fi

ISSUE_TITLE=$(printf '%s' "$_issue_json" | jq -r '.title')
printf '%s' "$_issue_json" | jq -r '.body' > "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/issue-body.txt"

# Clarify label?
HAS_CLARIFY_LABEL=false
if printf '%s' "$_issue_json" | jq -e '.labels[]? | select(.name == "needs-design-clarification")' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  HAS_CLARIFY_LABEL=true
fi

# Resolve REPO
REPO=""
REPO=$("<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/47.0.70/scripts/resolve-repo.sh" 2>/dev/null) || REPO=""
if [ -z "$REPO" ]; then
  REPO=$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner --jq '.nameWithOwner' 2>/dev/null) || REPO=""
fi

printf 'ISSUE_NUMBER=%s\n' "$ISSUE_NUMBER"
printf 'ISSUE_TITLE=%s\n' "$ISSUE_TITLE"
printf 'HAS_CLARIFY_LABEL=%s\n' "$HAS_CLARIFY_LABEL"
printf 'REPO=%s\n' "$REPO"
printf 'LABELS=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$_issue_json" | jq -r '[.labels[]?.name] | join(",")')"
printf -- '----- ISSUE BODY -----\n'
cat "$DESIGN_TMPDIR/issue-body.txt"
